independence.mechanism: Single fresh assigned critic; no descendants/subagents; no model/effort change requested or made. Only the sealed packet was used as external task input; all working-directory and artifact writes were confined to review-r2. No earlier reviews/scores/findings, Lead evidence/checks, live repository content, historical links, external sites, application imports/execution, models/providers, PostgreSQL or native helpers were accessed.
independence.limits: Shared filesystem is not a security isolation boundary. Pre/post file membership and byte hashes detect endpoint changes, not transient mutate-and-restore activity. Model/effort inheritance and freshness are assignment properties, not independently attestable by Python. This bounded review does not prove runtime safety or exhaust every implementation choice. No skill or repository-wide workflow was loaded because the assignment expressly restricts inputs to the packet.

execution.bootstrap: The initial pwd command ran before the self-recording check wrapper; its exact command, exit and streams are reproduced from the tool result in bootstrap.json. Wrapper/bootstrap and artifact-writing invocations are not separately self-instrumented; check-01 through check-10 contain the exact Python check argv, exit and complete captured stdout/stderr.
execution.emptyStreams: Successful checks have empty stderr; these are retained as empty JSON strings. No empty evidence file is included.
execution.truncation: Tool presentation of check-02 and the combined check-06/check-07 output was truncated. Their stored stdout/stderr are complete (truncated=false refers to stored streams). Candidate lines 61–367 were re-read in bounded check-04/check-05, and necessary current-source context was re-read in check-08/check-09. Truncation was not treated as source evidence.
execution.stopRule: Finalized on the completed C1–C6 document judgement; no runtime validation or additional exploration loops followed.
